primarina.blurb: Your voice is your power, and you use it beautifully. You're expressive and warm, a performer with real discipline behind the sparkle, and you'd rather move people than beat them. You love your people and you sing it. You're Primarina: graceful, gifted, and born for the stage.
primarina.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): controls water balloons with its singing voice and performs with grace; each one has its own song passed down the family.

lycanroc.title: The Loyal Wolf
lycanroc.blurb: You're loyal and you're wild, and you don't see why you'd have to pick. You're fiercely competitive, quick to taunt, and quick to defend your pack, and you need a partner who can keep up. You run hot and you run hard. You're Lycanroc: devoted, fierce, and never tame.
lycanroc.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): the Midday form is obedient and loyal; the Midnight form taunts foes and loves a fight; anime: Ash's Dusk Lycanroc, fierce and faithful.

wishiwashi.title: The Strength in Numbers
wishiwashi.blurb: On your own, you worry; together, you're terrifying. You're a team person through and through, loyal and a little anxious, and you do your best work shoulder to shoulder with people you trust. Nobody should underestimate what happens when you all show up. You're Wishiwashi: humble, loyal, and strongest in a crowd.
wishiwashi.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): weak and teary alone, but when it schools it terrifies even Gyarados; the species that is only strong together.

mudsdale.title: The Unflinching Workhorse
mudsdale.blurb: You just keep going. You're steady and tireless, unbothered by noise or pressure or weather, and you do the heavy work without a single complaint. Flash means nothing to you; finishing means everything. You're Mudsdale: enduring, dependable, and impossible to rattle.
mudsdale.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): carries ten tons across rough ground for three days and nights without rest, and nothing makes it panic; the embodiment of grit.

salazzle.title: The Pheromone Queen
salazzle.blurb: You run the room, and everyone knows it. You're confident and magnetic, a little ruthless, and extremely good at getting people to do what you want and enjoy it. You don't ask permission. You're Salazzle: commanding, charismatic, and in charge.
salazzle.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): leads a harem of Salandit with pheromones that make others do as it pleases; the queen who runs the show.

bewear.title: The Crushing Hugger
bewear.blurb: You love hard, sometimes too hard. You're warm and generous and a bit overwhelming, with no idea how strong you are, and the people you've adopted have long since given up resisting. You'd do anything for them, immediately. You're Bewear: affectionate, powerful, and dangerously huggable.
bewear.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): its friendly hugs are strong enough to crush, so it must be approached with care; anime: Team Rocket's unbeatable, affectionate landlord.

tsareena.title: The Haughty Queen
tsareena.blurb: You have standards, and you enforce them. You're elegant and formidable, a little scornful of people who don't try, and fiercely protective of the ones who look up to you. You lead from the front and you win in heels. You're Tsareena: regal, ruthless, and secretly devoted.
tsareena.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): haughty and merciless with its kicks, scornful of the weak, yet it protects every Bounsweet in its care; the queen who earns the crown.

comfey.title: The Flower Healer
comfey.blurb: You make people feel better, and you do it on purpose. You're cheerful and nurturing, organised in your kindness, and completely uninterested in winning anything. You'd rather decorate someone's day. You're Comfey: healing, warm, and a joy to have around.
comfey.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): picks flowers and hangs them on its vine, and the soothing scent heals the sick; it is used in Alola's hospitals.

oranguru.title: The Forest Sage
oranguru.blurb: You think before you act, and you think a lot. You're wise and observant, a little aloof, and generous in a careful, deliberate way: you help the ones who've earned it. You'd rather understand than compete. You're Oranguru: thoughtful, patient, and quietly profound.
oranguru.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): sits high in the trees thinking, uses tools and gives items to Pokemon it deems worthy; people once mistook it for a human; the sage.

passimian.title: The Team Player
passimian.blurb: You're nothing without the team, and you're proud of that. You're energetic and loyal, with a strong competitive streak that only ever points outward, and you'd rather pass the ball than take the shot. You'd give anything for your squad. You're Passimian: cooperative, committed, and built for the group.
passimian.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): lives in groups of about twenty, passing berries to each other and following a leader who's chosen for its throwing; teamwork is everything.

wimpod.title: The Nervous Scavenger
wimpod.blurb: You're scared of a lot, and you keep going anyway. You're gentle and jumpy, quick to run and quick to come back, and you do more good than you realise by just tidying up after everyone. Bravery isn't the absence of fear; it's you. You're Wimpod: nervous, kind, and more useful than you know.
wimpod.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): a coward that flees at the slightest sound, but it cleans the beaches of whatever it finds; the anxious little helper.

pyukumuku.title: The Immovable
pyukumuku.blurb: You've found your spot and you're staying in it. You're calm and stubborn, completely unbothered by being told to move, and quietly content in a way other people find mysterious. Change isn't a threat; it's just not happening. You're Pyukumuku: immovable, serene, and perfectly fine, thanks.
pyukumuku.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): never leaves its spot, and if thrown back into the sea it crawls right back to where it was; the stubborn sea cucumber.

komala.title: The Dreaming Sleeper
komala.blurb: You're living in a dream and honestly it's going well. You're peaceful and unbothered, happy in your own head, and more or less immune to stress because you've never really woken up for it. People envy your calm. You're Komala: dreamy, serene, and holding on to your log.
komala.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): born asleep and dies asleep, living out its whole life in dreams while clutching a log; the serene sleeper.

mimikyu.title: The Lonely Disguise
mimikyu.blurb: You just want to be loved, and you've put a lot of work into the costume. You're shy and sincere, a little anxious, and far more loyal than the people who never looked under the rag deserved. Someone will see you properly. You're Mimikyu: lonely, loving, and worth the look.
mimikyu.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): wears a Pikachu rag so people will love it, and cries under the disguise when it's lonely; Mystery Dungeon: the misunderstood one.

drampa.title: The Grandparent Dragon
drampa.blurb: You're gentle with the little ones and terrifying to anyone who hurts them. You're warm and patient, happy to tell the same story twice, and your calm hides an absolutely volcanic protective streak. You don't compete; you look after. You're Drampa: kind, wise, and not to be tested.
drampa.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): gentle with children and loves to play with them, but if a child is hurt it goes on a furious rampage; the grandparent.

kommo-o.title: The Clanging Honour
kommo-o.blurb: You announce yourself, and you back it up. You're disciplined and proud, with a strong sense of honour and a love of a fair fight, and you train harder than anyone you compete with. You respect people who respect the rules. You're Kommo-o: honourable, loud, and ready.
kommo-o.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): clangs its scales to intimidate before a fight and trains relentlessly, battling only those it respects; the honourable dragon.

tapu-koko.title: The Fickle Guardian
tapu-koko.blurb: You're curious, impulsive, and impossible to predict. You love a good fight and a good surprise, you help people when you feel like it and vanish when you don't, and you've never once explained yourself. You're a storm with a sense of humour. You're Tapu Koko: wild, playful, and entirely your own.
tapu-koko.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): curious and fickle, it loves battles and lends power on a whim, then vanishes; anime: the guardian that picks a fight with Ash for fun.

grookey.title: The Stick Drummer
grookey.blurb: You've always got a beat going. You're upbeat and curious, a little restless, and you make things grow just by being around them. You'd rather jam than plan. You're Grookey: rhythmic, cheerful, and good for the garden.
grookey.why: Pokedex (SwSh): beats a rhythm with its stick that makes plants grow, and is endlessly curious; anime: Goh's Grookey, who drums on everything.

cinderace.title: The Striker
cinderace.blurb: You play to win and you play to the crowd. You're energetic and skilled, a bit of a show-off, and at your best when the stakes are high and people are watching. You've got the goal in sight before anyone else. You're Cinderace: fast, fiery, and the one who takes the shot.
cinderace.why: Pokedex (SwSh): juggles a pebble into a fireball and kicks it with pinpoint aim, but gets carried away showing off when the crowd cheers; the striker.

sobble.title: The Teary Chameleon
sobble.blurb: You cry easily, and you make everyone else cry with you, which is a skill. You're sensitive and shy, quick to vanish when things get loud, and much braver on the inside than the outside shows. You care enormously. You're Sobble: tender, timid, and growing into something fierce.
sobble.why: Pokedex (SwSh): turns invisible in water, and its tears are so potent that everyone around starts crying too; anime: Goh's Sobble, hiding in his hood.

corviknight.title: The Sky Taxi Knight
corviknight.blurb: You get people where they need to go, reliably, without drama. You're calm and disciplined, with a steely sense of duty and no patience for nonsense, and you're more capable in a crisis than almost anyone. You don't need thanks. You're Corviknight: composed, dependable, and armoured all the way through.
corviknight.why: Pokedex (SwSh): highly intelligent and calm, it carries people across Galar as the Flying Taxi and is the terror of the skies; the stoic knight.

wooloo.title: The Woolly Follower
wooloo.blurb: You go with the group and you avoid the fuss. You're gentle and soft, happiest among your people, and when trouble starts you simply roll away from it, which is honestly a strategy. You're not here to fight. You're Wooloo: cosy, loyal, and wonderfully unbothered.
wooloo.why: Pokedex (SwSh): follows the herd, rolls away from trouble, and hates conflict; the gentle sheep of Galar.

yamper.title: The Treat-Driven Pup
yamper.blurb: You're everyone's best friend, especially if they've got snacks. You're loyal and bouncy, a little food-motivated, and the kind of presence that makes a bad day better just by showing up. You'd follow your people anywhere, at a jog. You're Yamper: joyful, devoted, and extremely good.
yamper.why: Pokedex (SwSh): herds livestock, chases after anything that runs, and only really moves when it's expecting a treat; the corgi.

cramorant.title: The Gulping Goof
cramorant.blurb: You commit to the bit. You're a bit scatterbrained and a lot stubborn, and once you've got hold of something you're not letting go, however little sense it makes. People find you baffling and endearing in equal measure. You're Cramorant: goofy, tenacious, and never spitting it out.
cramorant.why: Pokedex (SwSh): swallows anything that fits in its beak and refuses to let go, even a Pikachu; a bit dim, entirely committed.

toxtricity.title: The Rock Star
toxtricity.blurb: You're loud on purpose. You're a performer and a rebel, bored by rules and thrilled by a crowd, and you'd rather be electric than correct. You're a bit chaotic and completely magnetic. You're Toxtricity: amped, defiant, and headlining.
toxtricity.why: Pokedex (SwSh): strums the protrusions on its chest to make thunderous noise and stirs up a crowd; Amped Form is wild, Low Key is cooler; the punk rocker.

hatterene.title: The Forest Witch
hatterene.blurb: You need quiet, and you'll make it if you have to. You're deeply private and highly sensitive, with a rich inner world and very little patience for people who intrude on it. Loud rooms hurt. Your forest is your own. You're Hatterene: solitary, powerful, and not to be disturbed.
hatterene.why: Pokedex (SwSh): hates noise and strong emotions, and strikes down intruders with its psychic claws from its forest home; the witch who wants to be left alone.

obstagoon.title: The Punk Blocker
obstagoon.blurb: You stand in the way on purpose. You're loud, tough, and fiercely protective of your own, and you'd much rather meet trouble head-on than wait for it. You've got a punk heart and a family soul. You're Obstagoon: defiant, loyal, and extremely hard to get past.
obstagoon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): blocks, screams, and then strikes, with a voice that shakes the air; it protects its family and never backs down from a brawl.

sirfetchd.title: The Fair Knight
sirfetchd.blurb: You fight fair or you don't fight. You're disciplined and honourable, old-fashioned in the best way, and you'd rather lose with dignity than win with a trick. People trust you completely and they should. You're Sirfetch'd: noble, dependable, and a knight to the end.
sirfetchd.why: Pokedex (SwSh): fights fair and never ambushes, and when its leek withers it retires from battle; the chivalrous knight of Galar.

falinks.title: The Formation
falinks.blurb: You move as one with your people. You're disciplined and loyal, with an almost military sense of order and no interest in going it alone. You win because everyone does their part. You're Falinks: coordinated, committed, and strongest in formation.
falinks.why: Pokedex (SwSh): six individuals that act as one, with a brass commanding five troopers in perfect formation; the team that never breaks.

indeedee.title: The Mind-Reading Butler
indeedee.blurb: You know what people need before they ask. You're attentive and organised, gentle and devoted, and you take real satisfaction in a job done perfectly for someone you care about. You don't need the spotlight. You're Indeedee: thoughtful, faithful, and quietly indispensable.
indeedee.why: Pokedex (SwSh): reads feelings with its horns and anticipates what its trainer needs, serving faithfully; the butler Pokemon.

morpeko.title: The Hangry Switch
morpeko.blurb: You're delightful until you're hungry, and then you're a different person. You run on snacks and feelings, and both change fast. People learn to keep a seed packet handy. You're Morpeko: lovable, moody, and always one meal away from chaos.
morpeko.why: Pokedex (SwSh): constantly hungry, swinging between a cheerful Full Belly Mode and a furious Hangry Mode; the mood on legs.

dragapult.title: The Family Missile
dragapult.blurb: You're fast, a little mysterious, and surprisingly family-minded. You're competitive and clever, happy to launch the people you love at their goals, and gentle with them afterwards. You see the invisible angles. You're Dragapult: swift, strategic, and secretly a parent.
dragapult.why: Pokedex (SwSh): fires the Dreepy living in its horns like missiles, and the Dreepy enjoy it; outside battle it plays with them gently.

zacian.title: The Hero's Blade
zacian.blurb: You're the one who steps forward when everyone else steps back. You're calm and formidable, with a strong moral core and no need for an audience, and you'd rather act than announce. Legends are made of people like you. You're Zacian: heroic, steadfast, and sharper than anyone expects.
zacian.why: Pokedex (SwSh): the hero that saved Galar, it fights with a sword in its mouth and fells anything in one blow; the silent knight of legend.

zarude.title: The Jungle Pack
zarude.blurb: You protect your pack and you're wary of everyone else. You're tough and territorial, with a hidden softness for the ones you've chosen, and you'd break your own rules for them. The jungle is home. You're Zarude: fierce, protective, and loyal in your own way.
zarude.why: Pokedex (SwSh): lives in packs deep in the jungle and treats outsiders with hostility; Secrets of the Jungle: Dada Zarude raises a human child as its own.

meowscarada.title: The Masked Magician
meowscarada.blurb: You dazzle on purpose, and the trick is already done. You're creative and clever, a little vain, and very good at making people look where you want them to. You prefer applause to approval. You're Meowscarada: showy, sly, and a step ahead of the audience.
meowscarada.why: Pokedex (SV): a showy magician that dazzles with flashy tricks, then plants a seed bomb while you're watching the wrong hand; Sprigatito loves attention.

fuecoco.title: The Laid-Back Foodie
fuecoco.blurb: You've got your priorities straight: food, friends, and no rush whatsoever. You're warm and easygoing, impossible to stress, and happiest with a full plate and good company. Ambition can wait until after lunch. You're Fuecoco: relaxed, affectionate, and always hungry.
fuecoco.why: Pokedex (SV): laid back and does things at its own pace, with food above everything; it absorbs the heat of a good meal to power its flame.

quaquaval.title: The Dancing Rival
quaquaval.blurb: You turn everything into a performance and then you win it. You're exuberant and competitive, full of rhythm and pride, and you'd rather out-dance someone than out-argue them. The crowd is your natural habitat. You're Quaquaval: flamboyant, fierce, and fabulous.
quaquaval.why: Pokedex (SV): dances with a rhythm that makes foes want to join in, and feels an intense rivalry with anyone who dances better; the showstopper.

lechonk.title: The Gentle Glutton
lechonk.blurb: You're soft, you're sweet, and you're always thinking about the next snack. You're easygoing and kind, a bit timid in a crowd, and surprisingly quick when something alarming happens. You don't need to win anything. You're Lechonk: gentle, content, and extremely lovable.
lechonk.why: Pokedex (SV): timid and gentle, it hunts for fragrant herbs and will eat anything, surprising people with its speed when startled; the hog with a heart.

maushold.title: The Family First
maushold.blurb: You've got a family and that's the whole plan. You're warm and sociable, organised in a domestic sort of way, and you'd never do anything that left someone behind. Together is the only way you work. You're Maushold: close-knit, caring, and never alone.
maushold.why: Pokedex (SV): a family of three or four that does everything together, the little ones following their parents; the species that puts family first.

fidough.title: The Friendly Loaf
fidough.blurb: You're warm, soft, and genuinely good for people. You're friendly to everyone, a bit of a people-pleaser, and happiest when the whole house smells like something baking. You don't do conflict. You're Fidough: sweet, sociable, and rising nicely.
fidough.why: Pokedex (SV): a friendly, popular puppy whose breath yeast is used in baking; it loves people and is loved back.

armarouge.title: The Loyal Knight
armarouge.blurb: You do things properly, and you'd rather lose than cheat. You're disciplined and dutiful, calm under pressure, and loyal to the people and principles you've chosen. You don't need to be loud to be strong. You're Armarouge: honourable, steady, and armoured in integrity.
armarouge.why: Pokedex (SV): wears armour inherited from the Ceruledge line and refuses to fight dirty, fighting only with honour; the loyal, disciplined knight.

ceruledge.title: The Ghostly Swordsman
ceruledge.blurb: You carry something old and you fight with it. You're disciplined and solitary, driven by a grudge you've turned into a craft, and you'd rather be respected than understood. Your blade is steady. You're Ceruledge: haunted, precise, and merciless.
ceruledge.why: Pokedex (SV): fights with blades of fire and bitter regret, moving with a swordsman's grace and showing mercy to no one; the dark mirror of Armarouge.

mabosstiff.title: The Big Softie
mabosstiff.blurb: You look intimidating and you're actually the gentlest person anyone knows. You're loyal and steady, with a tough exterior and a soft, family-first heart, and you'd stand between your people and anything. You don't need to prove it. You're Mabosstiff: protective, devoted, and a big softie.
mabosstiff.why: Pokedex (SV): looks fierce but is devoted to its family and gentle with children; anime and games: Arven's Mabosstiff, the heart of the Paldea story.

tinkaton.title: The Hammer Hunter
tinkaton.blurb: You built your own hammer and you know how to use it. You're crafty and competitive, a little cheeky, and not remotely intimidated by anything bigger than you. You pick your targets and you don't miss. You're Tinkaton: resourceful, fierce, and a lot of fun at a scrapyard.
tinkaton.why: Pokedex (SV): builds a hammer from scrap metal and hunts Corviknight with it, knocking them out of the sky for fun; the small, dangerous crafter.

greavard.title: The Lonely Ghost Pup
greavard.blurb: You just want someone to stay. You're affectionate and loyal, a little lonely, and you have a way of accidentally overwhelming people with how much you care. The right person won't mind at all. You're Greavard: devoted, gentle, and waiting by the door.
greavard.why: Pokedex (SV): friendly and loyal, it follows anyone who shows it kindness, draining their life force without meaning to; the ghost dog who just wants company.

annihilape.title: The Rage That Outlived Death
annihilape.blurb: You've been angry so long it's become a kind of calm. You're intense and driven, patient in a way that unsettles people, and when the rage comes it's absolute. You don't forgive and you don't quit. You're Annihilape: focused, furious, and beyond stopping.
annihilape.why: Pokedex (SV): its rage was so strong it transcended death, and it now fights with an unnerving calm until the fury erupts; the ghost of Primeape's anger.

kingambit.title: The Commander
kingambit.blurb: You command, and you earned the right. You're strategic and disciplined, with a ruthless clarity about what it takes to win and no patience for anyone who can't keep up. Respect is given to you, not asked for. You're Kingambit: calculating, dominant, and at the top for a reason.
kingambit.why: Pokedex (SV): leads an army of Bisharp and only the strongest, most ruthless Bisharp rises to become one; it wins by strategy as much as blades.

gholdengo.title: The Golden Charmer
gholdengo.blurb: You're the shiniest person at the party and you know it. You're friendly and flashy, easy to like and hard to hold onto, and you spend your charm as freely as your coins. People light up when you arrive. You're Gholdengo: golden, sociable, and never quite catchable.
gholdengo.why: Pokedex (SV): a friendly, flashy body of coins that charms everyone it meets and is surprisingly hard to pin down; the golden socialite.

ogerpon.title: The Masked Outsider
ogerpon.blurb: You've been on the outside, and it made you fiercely loyal to the few who let you in. You're playful and sensitive, a bit wary of crowds, and you hide more behind the mask than people realise. The right people see you. You're Ogerpon: misunderstood, brave, and true to your own.
ogerpon.why: Pokedex (SV DLC): mischievous and lonely, it lived apart from the village that feared it and stayed loyal to the one human who loved it; the outsider with a mask.
